factions.name: Strength
factions.description: Governs damage dealt and knockback force; higher Strength means harder-hitting attacks on opponents.

factions.name: Dexterity
factions.description: Governs recovery time after an attack; higher Dexterity means faster strings and combo potential.

factions.name: Defense
factions.description: Governs damage and knockback reduction when struck; higher Defense means greater survivability.

factions.name: Speed
factions.description: Governs run speed, acceleration and air movement; higher Speed means faster stage mobility.

cards.name: Bödvar
cards.description: Original viking Legend and one of Brawlhalla's four starting characters, wielding Sword and Hammer with an even Strength/Dexterity base.

cards.name: Cassidy
cards.description: Cowgirl gunslinger wielding dual Blasters and a Grapple Hammer; her 8 Dexterity is the standout stat, built for fast strings.

cards.name: Orion
cards.description: Martian warlord fighting with Spear and Rocket Lance; a well-rounded Legend with a slight edge in Strength and Speed.

cards.name: Diana
cards.description: Goddess-touched archer wielding Bow and Blasters; tuned for aggressive ranged pressure with matching Dexterity and Speed.

cards.name: Queen Nai
cards.description: Aztec warrior queen fighting with Katars and Spear; slow but the tankiest of the original roster at 8 base Defense.

cards.name: Ada
cards.description: Offense-first Legend wielding Blasters and Spear; high Dexterity and Speed come at the cost of very low Defense.

cards.name: Gnash
cards.description: Feral variant of humanity wielding Hammer and Spear; hits hard and moves fast but has poor Dexterity.

cards.name: Rayman
cards.description: Brawlhalla's first crossover Legend (Ubisoft's Rayman), fighting with Gauntlets and Axe; balanced with a slight bonus to Defense and Speed.

cards.name: Scarlet
cards.description: Steampunk inventor wielding Hammer and Rocket Lance; the highest base Strength in this set for heavy knockback.

cards.name: Thatch
cards.description: Pirate captain wielding the Boarding Cutlass (Sword) and Hand Cannons (Blasters); a fast, hard-hitting glass cannon with only 3 Defense.

cards.name: Ulgrim
cards.description: Dwarven berserker fighting with Axe and Rocket Lance; tanky with high Defense offset by his weakest stat, Dexterity.

cards.name: Ragnir
cards.description: Snow-tribe hunter wielding Katars and Axe; an evenly spread, well-rounded stat line.

cards.name: Ember
cards.description: Fast damage dealer wielding Katars and Bow; the highest Speed among this set but a paper-thin 3 Defense.

cards.name: Barraza
cards.description: Heavy-hitting Legend wielding Blasters and Axe; leads with 8 Defense, balanced against equally low Dexterity and Speed.

cards.name: Nix
cards.description: Reaper-like Legend wielding Scythe and Blasters; a defensive hit-sponge with the lowest Strength in this set.

cards.name: Jaeyun
cards.description: Versatile swordsman wielding Sword and Greatsword; stats are close to evenly split across all four categories.

cards.name: Tezca
cards.description: Jaguar-themed luchador and the first Legend to wield Battle Boots, paired with Gauntlets; a Strength-focused kicker/striker.

cards.name: Reno
cards.description: Blasters and Orb wielding Legend with a maxed-out Dexterity stat and solid Defense, but the weakest Strength alongside Nix.
